description.sl: Zadnja sobota v septembru. V Brdih vsi trgajo grozdje in vinogradnik Matteo potrebuje veliko pridnih rok.
description.en: The last Saturday of September. On the Collio hills everyone picks grapes, and Matteo the winemaker needs lots of helping hands.
description.de: Der letzte Samstag im September. In den Hügeln des Collio ernten alle Trauben, und Winzer Matteo braucht viele helfende Hände.

review: de: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: In September it's the grape harvest.
The grapes are sweet and ripe.
words.example_de: Die Trauben sind süß und reif.
words.note: Singular, like Slovene grozdje: l'uva (one grape: un acino).
words.note_sl: V ednini, kot grozdje: l'uva (ena jagoda: un acino).
words.note_de: Singular, wie slowenisch grozdje: l'uva (eine einzelne Beere: un acino).

words.example_en: I cut a bunch of grapes.

words.example_it: Sulla vite ci sono tanti grappoli.
words.example_en: There are lots of bunches on the vine.
words.note: Feminine, although it ends in -e: la vite.
words.note_sl: Ženskega spola, čeprav se konča na -e: la vite.
words.note_de: Feminin, obwohl es auf -e endet: la vite.

words.example_en: The basket is full of grapes.
We all pick the grapes together.
words.example_de: Wir pflücken alle zusammen die Trauben.
